description: Coach Bus Passengers per Month at Port Authority of NY NJ Airports: Beginning 2002 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. The Port Authority of New York & New Jersey quarterly produces a data file and provides information on monthly in-bound, out-bound, and connecting Coach Bus passengers between John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, and Newark Liberty International Airport; and between aforementioned airports and NYC bus stations beginning in 2002. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are bus passengers, ground transportation, the port authority of new york & new jersey, airport, coach bus. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: The Port Authority of New York & New Jersey. The portal shows 2016-11-10 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
